note: All file tokens as read with Paper get_tokens before the muted pink accent was adopted. The --color-accent-pink* tokens already existed as an unadopted exploration and are kept as they were. Restore with set_tokens (name, value, description) or create_tokens (type, name, value, description) for any token that is missing.

tokens.description: Pinned by Aariz.

tokens.description: Pinned by Aariz.

tokens.name: --color-surface-inverse

tokens.name: --color-text-primary

tokens.name: --color-text-secondary

tokens.name: --color-text-tertiary

tokens.name: --color-text-disabled
tokens.description: Disabled labels only (WCAG exempts inactive controls). 2.74:1, never for live text.

tokens.name: --color-text-inverse

tokens.name: --color-text-inverse-tertiary

tokens.name: --color-border-subtle
tokens.description: Card edges and table row dividers. Decorative; never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: --color-border-default
tokens.description: Section dividers, chart gridlines.

tokens.name: --color-border-control
tokens.description: Input and chip outlines. 4.09:1 on cream-75 (meets 3:1 non-text).

tokens.name: --color-focus-ring
tokens.description: 2px ring, 2px offset in surface colour. 17.30:1.

tokens.name: --color-focus-ring-inverse
tokens.description: Focus ring on brown-900 surfaces.

tokens.name: --color-accent

tokens.name: --color-accent-pressed
tokens.description: PROVISIONAL. Pressed primary.

tokens.name: --color-accent-subtle
tokens.description: PROVISIONAL. Selected chip and segment background.

tokens.name: --color-on-accent
tokens.description: PROVISIONAL. Text on accent. 17.30:1 on brown-900.

tokens.name: --color-state-gain
tokens.description: PROVISIONAL. Gain figures. Always with ▲ and +. 11.67:1 on cream-75.

tokens.name: --color-state-loss
tokens.description: PROVISIONAL. Loss figures. Always with ▼ and − (U+2212). 11.67:1 on cream-75.

tokens.name: --color-state-warning
tokens.description: PROVISIONAL. Over budget, TFSA room nearly used. Always with icon and text. 8.07:1.

tokens.name: --color-state-error
tokens.description: PROVISIONAL. Field errors: 2px border, icon, message. 17.30:1.

tokens.name: --color-state-bg
tokens.description: PROVISIONAL. Tint behind warning and error banners.

tokens.name: --color-accent-inverse

tokens.name: --color-accent-inverse-pressed
tokens.description: Pressed primary on the Coach card.

tokens.name: --color-accent-inverse-subtle
tokens.description: Selected chip fill on the Coach card. Cream 75 text on it is 11.67:1.

tokens.name: --color-on-accent-inverse
tokens.description: Label on --color-accent-inverse. 17.30:1.

tokens.name: --color-border-control-inverse
tokens.description: Secondary button and chip outline on the Coach card. 9.74:1 on Brown 900. Buy anyway uses this.

tokens.name: --color-border-inverse-subtle
tokens.description: Dividers and hairlines on the Coach card (2.14:1 on Brown 900). Decorative; never the only cue.

tokens.name: --color-skeleton
tokens.description: Skeleton shapes on light surfaces.

tokens.name: --color-skeleton-shimmer
tokens.description: The band that sweeps across light skeletons, 1400ms linear.

tokens.name: --color-skeleton-inverse
tokens.description: Skeleton shapes on the Coach card: Brown 700 on Brown 900, 2.14:1 (Brown 800 was 1.48:1 and disappeared).

tokens.name: --color-skeleton-inverse-shimmer
tokens.description: The band that sweeps across Coach-card skeletons, 1400ms linear; Brown 600 on Brown 900 is 3.02:1.

tokens.name: --color-brand-apple
tokens.description: Apple logo on Continue with Apple only. Brand mark, exempt from the cream/brown palette; Apple allows only a black or white logo.

tokens.name: --color-brand-google-blue
tokens.description: Google G, blue segment. Brand mark only; never UI.

tokens.name: --color-brand-google-green
tokens.description: Google G, green segment. Brand mark only; never UI.

tokens.name: --color-brand-google-yellow
tokens.description: Google G, yellow segment. Brand mark only; never UI.

tokens.name: --color-brand-google-red
tokens.description: Google G, red segment. Brand mark only; never UI or state.

tokens.name: --color-focus-halo
tokens.description: 3px halo outside a focused text field (outside its 1.5 Brown 900 border). Fields only; buttons, chips and rows use --color-focus-ring.

tokens.name: --color-shadow
tokens.description: Shadow colour for elevation. Always mixed with transparent: level 1 at 6% (0 1px 2px, 0 4px 12px), level 2 at 8% and 14% (0 2px 6px, 0 12px 32px). Never used solid.

tokens.name: --color-accent-pink
tokens.description: Exploration, not adopted. Muted pink for fills and small brand marks: selected tab block, selected segment, app-icon tile. Never text on cream (2.05:1). Brown 900 on it is 8.42:1. Never marks gain/loss, warning, or one of two choices.

tokens.name: --color-accent-pink-deep
tokens.description: Exploration. Text, icons, outlines and rings on light surfaces: 6.29 on Cream 50, 6.08 on Cream 75, 5.63 on Cream 100, 5.15 on Cream 150, 5.34 on pink-subtle.

tokens.name: --color-accent-pink-subtle
tokens.description: Exploration. Tint surface for a callout or the user's own row. Only 1.14:1 against Cream 75, so always pair it with a pink or pink-deep edge. Brown 900 on it 15.22, Brown 700 7.10.

tokens.name: --color-on-accent-pink
tokens.description: Exploration. Text and icons on a pink fill: 8.42:1.

tokens.name: --color-text-pink-inverse
tokens.description: Exploration. Pink text on the Brown 900 Coach card: 8.42:1. Non-choice text only (item caption, recorded answers).

tokens.name: --color-focus-ring-pink
tokens.description: Exploration. 2px focus ring on light surfaces: 6.08 on Cream 75, 5.15 on Cream 150.

tokens.name: --color-focus-ring-pink-inverse
tokens.description: Exploration. 2px focus ring on the Coach card: 8.42 on Brown 900. Applies to both doors equally.

tokens.name: --font-sans
tokens.description: The only family. Width 100 for Coach and body; width 87.5 (font-stretch: 87.5%) for dense tables. Always font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on figures.

tokens.name: --font-serif
tokens.description: Instrument Serif, italic 400 only. The coach's voice at a moment: the question on the Coach card, the Welcome tagline, Your call., Principles titles. Never figures, tables, buttons, inputs, labels or body. 28px and up; never below 24px.

tokens.name: --text-caption
tokens.description: Timestamps, delayed-quote labels, fine print.

tokens.name: --text-label
tokens.description: Buttons, chips, field labels, table cells (at width 87.5).

tokens.name: --text-body-lg
tokens.description: Coach body copy and answers.

tokens.name: --text-title-3

tokens.name: --text-title-1
tokens.description: Screen titles.

tokens.name: --text-display
tokens.description: The coach question. One per screen.

tokens.name: --text-figure-xl

tokens.name: --text-table

tokens.name: --text-serif-title

tokens.name: --text-serif-display

tokens.name: --text-serif-hero

tokens.name: --spacing-16
tokens.description: Phone screen gutter.

tokens.name: --spacing-touch
tokens.description: Minimum touch target, both axes.

tokens.name: --spacing-safe-bottom
tokens.description: iPhone home-indicator inset under a fixed footer or a full-height Coach card area. Not a spacing step; never used for gaps.

tokens.name: --icon-sm
tokens.description: Icon size small: inline with Caption/Label text, chips, field adornments. Width and height of the icon frame.

tokens.name: --icon-md
tokens.description: Icon size medium: buttons, list rows, spinners. Width and height of the icon frame.

tokens.name: --icon-lg
tokens.description: Icon size large: tab bar, top bar Back/Close, empty states. Width and height of the icon frame.

tokens.name: --size-chip-category
tokens.description: Width of each category chip on the Check-in entry (44 high). Three fit per row in the 358 content width with 12 gaps, so no chip, such as "Not sure", ends up alone on a line. Paper has no size type, so it is filed as spacing, like the icon sizes.

tokens.name: --radius-sm
tokens.description: Inner elements: anything inside a padded container (buttons and chips on the Coach card, images and skeleton bars in cards), and the inner half of a tight nest (segment in a track, button in an input, chip in a chip track, pressed row in a row group).

tokens.name: --radius-md
tokens.description: Standalone controls on the page: buttons, chips, the tab-bar selection, inline notices, chip tracks.

tokens.name: --radius-lg
tokens.description: Containers, the maximum radius: cards, Coach card, sheets (top corners), dialogs, toasts, row groups, inputs, segmented tracks.

tokens.name: --radius-full
tokens.description: Circles only: switch tracks and thumbs, pay-date circles, avatar dots, legend dots, rings. Never chips, buttons or cards.

tokens.name: --radius-none
tokens.description: Square: an element flush against its container's edge (a full-bleed image or rule inside a card).
